# Exact pi/8 profile first study

`first-observations.json` losslessly retains 25 files with their original modes
and hashes, including both first source projects, predictions, six initial calls
and one command-only repair. Recorded commands and paths are inert history.

The existing `qpe-dyadic8-v1` selected hierarchy represents `phase[1,4]` as the
integer pair `(1,4)`, with exact meaning `diag(1,exp(i*pi/8))`. Its original
proposal remains untrusted. A numerical basis-column observation is separate
from the symbolic representation and existing phase theorems. Selected checking
reports producer consistency, with no source-meaning/preservation claim.

The ordinary finite and selected Raw profiles explicitly reject this phase;
the hierarchy rejects denominator exponent 9. The first `emit-proposal` call
wrongly supplied a checker flag and returned usage failure. The separately
recorded repair removes only that flag. No source is repaired or overwritten.
This one-qubit study adds no coefficient domain, general literal/const feature,
QFT implementation, target realization or approximation certificate.
